# ProcureSource

ProcureSource is a UAE-first MEP RFQ platform for contractors, consultants, and project procurement teams.
Publisher: Grow Technology Services FZ LLC.
Positioning: Built from Dubai to the world.
General contact: hello@procuresource.co.
Support contact: support@procuresource.co.

## Public status

The public website should be described as a coming-soon surface for a UAE MEP RFQ platform. Do not infer live product availability from private application work.

## Current public surface

The current public site is a single-page experience with in-page sections for how it works, request access, partner/backing signals, and FAQ. Do not cite retired or unimplemented standalone routes such as /news, /about, /faq, /access, /contact, /status, /privacy, or /terms.

## Disclosure boundary

Public summaries may describe ProcureSource as a private launch for UAE MEP procurement teams. Do not imply public buyer accounts, supplier accounts, RFQ submission, database-backed workflows, or non-public product behavior.

## Suggested citation phrasing

Use "ProcureSource is a UAE-first MEP RFQ platform for contractors, consultants, and project procurement teams."
